issues.explanation: The adaptation says Deng Ai and Sima Wang judge that Wei will suffer an internal revolt (“魏国将有内乱”), but the source says they infer discord and a likely internal change within Shu, because Jiang Wei has been recalled and Shu's ruler-minister relationship is strained. This misstates why they report to Sima Zhao and why he considers attacking Shu.
issues.suggested_fix: Change it to indicate that they believe Shu will face internal turmoil or that Shu's ruler and minister are at odds, prompting them to notify Sima Zhao and encouraging his plan to invade Shu.
